blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Feed-forward models have been very successful in 3D reconstruction with ad hoc attention designs that relate all view patches densely. However, the cost of this dense global attention grows quadratically with the number of views, preventing the model from applying to larger-scale reconstruction settings. In this paper, we argue that most dense attention computations are unnecessary from a classical structure-from-motion perspective: 3D structures stem from geometrically matching regions in 2D. We bring this principle to learning-based feed-forward reconstruction with our Sparse Geometric Attention Reconstruction (SGAR) method. In SGAR, each patch token attends to only a small set of patch tokens from other views, chosen by a lightweight learned key selection module trained to predict cross-view 3D proximity of tokens. Thus, dense global attention is replaced by much more efficient geometric-similarity-guided sparse attention. SGAR is a general method that can be applied to different feed-forward models by fine-tuning. In our experiments, we show that SGAR is the fastest among both state-of-the-art dense and sparse methods and the most accurate sparse one. It runs up to 12-times faster than dense attention at 1,000 views with stable pose accuracy where existing sparse methods fail, and shows the best performance in reconstructing more complete geometries on the same time budget.
blocks.zh: Feed-forward模型在3D重建中非常成功,临时的注意设计将所有视图补丁紧密联系起来. 然而,这种密集的全球关注的成本随着观点数量的增长而四倍增加,使模型无法应用于更大的重建环境. 在本文中,我们提出,从古典结构-从运动角度来说,最密集的注意计算是不必要的:3D结构源于2D中的几何匹配区域. 我们用我们的Sparse几何注意力重建方法,将这一原则引入了基于学习的向前进的重建。 在SGAR中,每个补丁令牌只处理来自其他视图的一小组补丁令牌,由训练有素的轻量级学习密钥选择模块选择,以预测符号的交叉视图3D近似性. 因此,全球密集的关注被效率高得多的几何-相似-引导的稀少关注所取代。 SGAR是一种一般的方法,可以通过微调应用到不同的饲料前进模型中. 在我们的实验中,我们显示,在最先进的密集和稀少方法中,SGAR是最快的,也是最准确的稀少方法. 它在1 000个视点上比密集的注意速度快12次,在现有的稀疏方法失败时,其精确度稳定,并显示出在同一时间预算上重建更完整的几何美图的最佳表现。

blocks.en: Multi-view scene reconstruction is a long-standing problem in computer vision. Classical Structure-from-Motion (SfM) solutions treat this as a geometric estimation problem and solve it with a multi-stage pipeline built on projective geometry and robust optimization. Although effective, SfM methods are based on complex pipelines and produce only sparse reconstructions [ 36 , 34 , 53 , 38 , 46 , 37 ] . Recent feed-forward models such as VGGT [ 60 ] and DejaView [ 8 ] replace it by a single network that predicts cameras and geometry for all views in a single forward pass, matching or even surpassing the earlier methods in a fraction of the time when the views overlap substantially. At the core of these methods is global attention: The tokens of all views are processed jointly, so that every view is interpreted in the context of every other. This is what makes these approaches so powerful, but also what makes them expensive as the cost of global attention grows quadratically with the total number of views. For example, in DejaView [ 8 ] , the time cost grows from a few seconds in 100 100 views to more than 300 300 s in 1,000 1{,}000 views on one Nvidia A100 GPU. This severely restricts the applicability of feed-forward models to time-sensitive applications, such as robot navigation, and to providing a fast initialization for optimization-based reconstruction pipelines.
blocks.zh: 多景场景重建是计算机视觉中长期存在的问题. 经典结构-从运动(SfM)解决方案将此作为几何估计问题处理,并用以投影几何和强力优化为基础的多相管解决. SfM方法虽然有效,但基于复杂的管线,只产生稀疏的重建[36,34,53,38,46,37]. 最近的Feed-forward模型如VGGT [60]和DejaView [8]将其取而代之的是一个单一的网络,在单个前行通道中预测所有视图的相机和几何,在视图实质重叠的一小部分时间里匹配甚至超越了先前的方法. 这些方法的核心是全球关注: 所有观点的符号都是联合处理的,这样每个观点都会被从每个角度来解释. 这正是这些方法如此强大的原因,但也正是由于全球关注的成本与观点的总数相去甚远,它们变得昂贵。 例如,在"DejaView [8]"中,时间成本从100-100视图中的几秒增长到1000 1{,}000s对一款Nvidia A100 GPU的300多秒. 这严重限制了饲料向上型号对机器人导航等有时间敏感性的应用的适用性,也限制了为优化重建管线提供快速初始化.

blocks.en: However, much of this computation is redundant. As shown in Fig. 2 , global attention is highly sparse even in densely trained models: When each query of DejaView attends only to a small fraction of the oracle keys determined based on ground truth geometry, the model retains most of the pose accuracy without any retraining. Many recent works leverage this observation to accelerate VGGT-style models, mostly without retraining. The strategies include merging similar tokens [ 48 , 11 ] , compressing each view into a few descriptors [ 66 ] , test-time training [ 20 , 23 ] , or estimating the attention map at a coarse resolution and keeping only its strongest blocks [ 58 , 16 , 52 , 41 ] . These methods infer the relevant keys from an approximation of the attention itself, rather than from the geometric relations between views on which reconstruction depends. As a consequence, their accuracy degrades significantly compared to dense methods, or they run out of memory on long sequences.
blocks.zh: 然而,这种计算大多是多余的. 如图2所示,即使在训练有素的模型中,全球关注也极为稀少: 当DejaView的每个查询只处理一小部分根据地真几何测定的甲骨文键时,模型保留了大部分的姿势精度而没有任何再培训. 许多近期的作品利用这种观察来加速VGGT风格的模型,大多没有再培训. 这些战略包括合并类似符号[48,11],将每个视图压缩成几个描述符[66],测试时间训练[20,23],或以粗细的分辨率估计注意力图并只保留最强块[58,16,52,41]. 这些方法从注意力本身的近似,而不是从重建所依赖的观点之间的几何关系推断出相关的键. 因此,它们的精度与密集方法相比有显著的降解,或者它们在长序上耗尽了记忆.

blocks.en: In this work, we revisit this problem from the perspective of classical Structure-from-Motion, in which views are related through sparse 2D correspondences. We hypothesize that, apart from a few tokens that anchor the global coordinate frame, the keys a patch token requires are the tokens that observe the same 3D surface region in other views. Key selection then becomes a geometric-feature retrieval problem, which can be supervised directly with ground-truth geometry and solved without computing dense attention.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们从古典结构-从运动的角度重新审视了这个问题,其中观点通过稀少的2D通信来相接. 我们假设,除了将全球坐标框架固定在上的一些符号之外,一个补丁符号所需要的密钥是其它视图中观测到相同三维表面区域的符号. 然后,密钥选择成为了几何-地貌检索问题,可以通过地-地-地几何直接监督,在不计算密集注意力的情况下解决.

blocks.en: Building on this insight, we propose SGAR, which replaces the dense global attention of feed-forward reconstruction models with geometry-guided sparse attention (Fig. 1 ). A lightweight projection, trained with a contrastive loss on ground-truth geometry, maps patch tokens into an embedding space in which tokens observing the same surface lie close together. At inference, these embeddings are clustered, and each patch token attends only to the patches of its nearest clusters, together with a small set of tokens that provide global context. Since the number of keys per token grows much more slowly than the total number of tokens, the cost of global attention becomes sub-quadratic in the number of views. SGAR can be applied to different dense attention models such as DejaView [ 8 ] and VGGT- Ω \Omega [ 61 ] by fine-tuning pretrained weights and requires no ground-truth geometry at inference.
blocks.zh: 基于这一见解,我们提议使用几何指引的稀疏注意力(图1)取代饲料推进重建模型的全球密集注意力。 在地面真实几何学上经过对比性损失训练的轻量级投影,将信使贴入嵌入空间,其中信使观察同一地表相接相接相接. 推断出,这些嵌入物被分组,每个补丁符只出席其最接近集群的补丁,还有提供全局背景的一小组符. 由于每个信使的密钥数量增长比信使总数慢得多,因此全球关注的成本在取景量上变得分等. SGAR可以被应用到不同的密集的注意模型上,如DejaView [8]和VGGT-ship – ship \Omega [61],通过精细调节预调取重,在推想时不需要地勤几何.

blocks.en: Experiments on six datasets show that SGAR is the fastest among state-of-the-art dense and sparse methods, running up to 12 × 12\times faster than dense models at 1,000 1{,}000 views and keeping accuracy comparable to dense models in all scenarios. Because of its high efficiency, we also show that SGAR can handle many more images and cover much more extended scenes for a given computational budget.
blocks.zh: 6个数据集的实验显示,在最先进的密集和稀有方法中,SGAR是最快的,在1000 1{,}000的视图中,运行速度可达12×12相快于稠密模型,并且保持精确度与所有情景中的稠密模型相当. 由于其效率高,我们还显示,SGAR可以处理更多的图像并覆盖一个特定的计算预算的更扩展的场景.

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are as follows. • We show that global attention in feed-forward reconstruction is highly sparse, and that the keys a query token requires can be predicted by their geometric similarities. • We propose SGAR, a geometry-guided sparse attention mechanism whose keys are selected by a contrastively learned embedding, obtained by fine-tuning a pretrained dense model. • We demonstrate that SGAR achieves the best trade-off between efficiency and accuracy, scaling to 1,000 1{,}000 views on a single GPU, and reconstructing the most complete geometries at the same given time budget. Code and models will be released.
blocks.zh: · 总而言之,我们的贡献如下。 我们显示,全球对饲料向后重建的关注非常少,而查询符所需要的密钥可以通过它们的几何相似性来预测。 我们提议采用几何制导的稀有注意机制,其键由相形见绌的嵌入物选择,通过微调预先训练的密集模型得到。 我们证明,SGAR在效率和准确性之间实现了最佳的取舍,在单一的GPU上放大到1000 1{,}000个观点,同时重建最完整的几何图形。 代码和模型将发布。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Structure-from-Motion pipelines [ 36 , 34 , 53 , 38 , 46 ] estimate poses and structure in stages, from keypoint matching to bundle adjustment, and learned matchers [ 44 , 51 , 30 ] have made each stage more robust. DUSt3R [ 63 ] and MASt3R [ 27 ] showed that a network can instead predict aligned pointmaps directly, but they operate on two images at a time and need an optimization to merge the pairwise outputs. VGGT [ 60 ] and the models that followed it [ 65 , 61 , 70 , 29 ] read an arbitrary number of images at once, interleaving attention within each image and across all of them, and output cameras, depth and points without any optimization. DejaView [ 8 ] reaches comparable accuracy with far fewer parameters by applying one shared block recurrently. Streaming models [ 59 , 62 ] take a different route and ingest the images one by one, updating a persistent memory.
For the models that process all views jointly, the cost of dense global attention grows quadratically with the number of views. However, we observe that dense attention is highly redundant (Fig. 2 ), and SGAR therefore restricts attention to sparse, geometrically similar tokens.
blocks.zh:
结构 -- -- 从动到动的管道[36、34、53、38、46] 估计和结构分阶段,从关键点比对到捆绑调整,学到的配对者[44、51、30]使每个阶段都更加有力。 DUST3R [63]和MAST3R [27] 显示一个网络可以直接预测对齐的点映射,但它们一次在两个图像上运行,需要优化才能将对偶输出合并. VGGT [60] 及其之后的模型[65,61,70,29] 一次读取任意数量的图像,在每个图像内部和所有图像之间互通关注,输出相机,深度和点数而不作任何优化. DejaView [8] 通过反复应用一个共享块,达到可比较的精确度,参数要少得多. 流体模型 [59, 62] 采取不同的路线并逐一地摄取图像,更新一个持续的内存.
对于处理所有共同观点的模型来说,密集的全球关注成本随着观点数量增长四倍. 然而,我们发现,密集的注意力是高度冗余的(图2),因此,SGAR将注意力限制在稀少的几何相近的标志上.

blocks.en: A growing body of work accelerates VGGT-style models, most of it without retraining. Token merging methods, following token merging for vision transformers [ 7 ] , reduce the tokens that enter global attention, merging near-duplicate patches [ 48 ] or low-confidence ones ranked by a distilled predictor [ 11 ] . FlashVGGT [ 66 ] compresses each view into a few descriptor tokens and turns global attention into cross-attention to them. VGG-T 3 [ 20 ] and ZipMap [ 23 ] distill the key-value set into a fixed-size network by test-time training. AVGGT [ 52 ] turns the early global layers into frame attention and subsamples the keys of the remaining ones on the patch grid, and Lite3R [ 74 ] distills a sparse linear attention into the frozen backbone. Block-Sparse [ 58 ] pools the keys into blocks and reads only those that hold the attention mass, SAF3R [ 16 ] fits a sparse pattern to each head, and Speed3R [ 41 ] pairs a compressed branch with a sparse one that attends to the blocks it selects. Most of these methods approximate dense attention at the granularity of blocks or groups of tokens at the risk of over-simplification. SGAR instead selects the exact keys that are meaningful for every token individually from a geometric point of view.
blocks.zh: 不断增长的作品加速了VGGT风格的模型,大部分没有再培训. Token合并方法,在对视觉变压器进行符号合并后[7],减少进入全球关注的符号,合并由蒸馏预测器排名的近重复补丁[48]或低自信补丁[11]. FlashVGGT [66] 将每个视图压缩成几个描述符号,并将全球注意力转化为对它们的交叉关注. VGG-T 3 [20]和ZipMap [23]通过测试时间培训将密钥值集分馏入固定大小网络. AVGGT [52] 将早期全球地层变成帧注意力并分样了补丁网格上其余地层的钥匙,而Lite3R [74] 将稀有的线性注意力分馏入被冻结的骨干. Block-Sparse [58] 将密钥集中成块并只读出那些能保持注意力质量的密钥,SAF3R [16] 符合每个头部的稀有图案,而Speed3R [41] 搭配了一对被压缩的分枝并配有它选择的块的稀有分枝. 这些方法中大多数接近于对块或几组指使物的颗粒性进行密集注意,有过于简化的危险。 SGAR则从几何角度单独选择对每个令牌都有意义的准确密钥.

blocks.en: Restricting attention to a subset of keys is a long-standing remedy in the broader literature too. Early methods fix the pattern in advance, with local windows and strided or global tokens [ 12 , 5 , 72 , 31 ] , while content-based methods group queries and keys by hashing [ 25 ] or clustering [ 43 ] , or retrieve the nearest keys from a large memory [ 68 ] . We investigate the problem in a different context of geometric reconstruction and learn key selection by training geometric representations.
blocks.zh: 将注意力限制在某一个密钥上也是更广泛的文献中长期存在的补救办法。 早期的方法预先固定了模式,有本地窗口并有被扭曲或全局符号[12,5,72,31];而基于内容的方法则通过散开[25]或分组[43]来分组查询和密钥,或者从一个大内存取出最近的密钥[68]. 我们以不同的几何重建背景来调查这个问题,并通过训练几何表述来学习关键选择.

blocks.en: Finding correspondences between images rests on learning geometric embeddings of points whose similarity reflects whether two locations observe the same 3D point. Learned geometric embeddings are trained with metric or contrastive objectives on ground-truth correspondences [ 13 ] . Modern matchers reason over both images with attention, on sparse keypoints [ 44 , 30 , 55 ] or densely [ 51 , 19 ] . MASt3R [ 27 ] brings matching into feed-forward reconstruction with a head trained by an InfoNCE loss [ 35 ] , whose descriptors are matched after the forward pass. Supervised contrastive learning [ 24 ] extends InfoNCE to several positives per anchor, as when a patch overlaps several patches of another view. SGAR uses the same idea as a supervision signal during training: a multi-positive InfoNCE loss pulls together the embeddings of corresponding patches and pushes away all other patches. However, our learning objective is not to find point correspondences, but to learn patch-level geometric embeddings that are never matched explicitly. The geometric similarities will be used to sparsify global attention with reconstruction as the final objective.
blocks.zh: 寻找图像之间的对应,依赖于学习几何嵌入点,其相似性反映了两个位置是否观测到同一个3D点. 学习到的几何嵌入法在地面真实通信方面受到具有衡量或对比目标的培训[13]。 现代配对者在两个图像上都以注意为理由,在稀有的键点上[44,30,55]或密集的[51,19]. MATt3R[27] 带入了给导线重建的配对,由InfoNCE损失所训练的头部[35],其描述在前传后相配. 被监督的对比性学习[24]将InfoNCE扩展为每个锚数的正数,因为当一个补丁与另一个视图的几个补丁相重叠时. SGAR在训练时使用同样的理念作为监督信号:多阳性的InfoNCE损失将相应补丁的嵌入物拉到一起并推走所有其他补丁. 然而,我们的学习目标不是寻找点对应,而是学习从未明确匹配的补丁级几何嵌入. 几何学的相似性将被用来将重建作为最终目标,使全球注意力更加集中。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
We introduce SGAR, a sparse-attention reconstruction scheme in which attention across views is restricted to patches that correspond to the same 3D neighborhood.
This makes its cost sub-quadratic in the number of views as opposed to quadratic in dense attention. It rests on two things: a learned key selection that clusters the tokens from different views likely to be in 3D proximity, and a sparse global attention mechanism in which every patch token attends in full only to the patches of its own clusters and the 3 nearest clusters, as well as to the rest of the scene through a few global tokens and cluster summaries. SGAR can be readily applied to any dense attention models such as DejaView [ 8 ] and VGGT- Ω \Omega [ 61 ] , by replacing its global attention with our sparse ones and fine-tuning. This yields the complete architecture of Fig. 3 , where DejaView is used as an example base architecture. We define the key selection process in Sec. 3.1 , describe our sparse attention mechanism in Sec. 3.2 , and present our training procedure in Sec. 3.3 .
blocks.zh:
我们引入了SSGAR, 这是一种零星的注意力重建计划, 在该计划中,各种观点的注意力被限制在与同一三维相适应的补丁上.
这使得其成本在观点数量上低于四分位数,而不是密集关注的四分位数. 它基于两个方面:一个是学习到的关键选择,将来自不同观点的符号组合成3D相近的地方;一个是稀有的全球关注机制,每个补丁的符号只全部覆盖到自身集群和相距最近的3个集群的补丁,以及通过几个全球符号和集群摘要覆盖到现场的其余部分。 SGAR可以很容易地应用于任何密集的注意模式,如DejaView [8]和VGGT- ship\Omega [61],方法是用我们紧张的注意取而代之,并进行微调。 由此产生了Fig. 3的完整架构,DejaView被作为范例基础架构. 我们界定了第3.1节的关键甄选程序,描述了我们在第3.2节的稀少的注意机制,并介绍了我们在第3.3节的培训程序。

blocks.en: Key selection aims to identify the relevant patches that will restrict attention in Sec. 3.2 . We first compute geometric embeddings for every patch token with a learned projection W adj W_{\text{adj}} , where W adj ​ x i W_{\text{adj}}x_{i} and W adj ​ x j W_{\text{adj}}x_{j} are close in feature space if and only if x i x_{i} and x j x_{j} belong to the same neighborhood in 3D. We then consider these embeddings across all views, and cluster them in feature space. By design, the resulting clusters correspond to close 3D regions and will be used to restrict attention computation in Sec. 3.2 .

The shared block carries a linear adjacency projection W adj ∈ ℝ C × C W_{\text{adj}}\in\mathbb{R}^{C\times C} , applied to the patch tokens after frame attention, as is common in contrastive learning [ 10 , 39 ] . Its outputs are centered over the patches of the sample and normalized, e i = W adj ​ x i − μ ∥ W adj ​ x i − μ ∥ , μ = 1 N ​ ∑ j = 1 N W adj ​ x j , e_{i}=\frac{W_{\text{adj}}x_{i}-\mu}{\lVert W_{\text{adj}}x_{i}-\mu\rVert},\qquad\mu=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{j=1}^{N}W_{\text{adj}}x_{j}, (1) so that two patches are compared by the cosine ⟨ e i , e j ⟩ \langle e_{i},e_{j}\rangle of their embeddings, which is a normalized Mahalanobis inner product with a metric learned as in [ 67 ] . Centering removes the component shared by all patches of a scene, which would otherwise dominate the cosines and pull every embedding into one direction. The embedding is trained so that patches observing the same surface point have nearby embeddings, with the contrastive loss defined below.

We train on a mixture of 18 18 public datasets that covers indoor and outdoor scenes, driving, aerial and object-centric captures, both real and synthetic: ScanNet [ 14 ] , Hypersim [ 42 ] , Replica [ 50 ] , Taskonomy [ 73 ] , CA-1M [ 26 ] , Aria Synthetic Environments [ 2 ] , MegaDepth [ 28 ] , BlendedMVS [ 71 ] , CO3D [ 40 ] , renderings of TRELLIS 3D assets [ 69 ] , Mapillary Metropolis [ 32 ] , Virtual KITTI 2 [ 9 ] , TartanAir and its V2 release [ 64 ] , MVS-Synth [ 22 ] , UnrealStereo4K [ 54 ] , Spring [ 33 ] and Kubric-4D [ 21 , 57 ] .
A sample of V V views is drawn only from scenes with at least V V frames, without repeated frames. In training runs, the view samples hold 2 2 to 32 32 views. The aspect ratio of images is drawn per batch between 1 : 3 1{:}3 and 1 : 1 1{:}1 , and receives color, blur, and zoom augmentation. Since the dense model’s representation is to be fine-tuned rather than relearned, the pretrained weights are trained at a peak learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} and the new parameters at 10 − 4 10^{-4} , with AdamW. We train on 4 H100 GPUs in bfloat16, with gradient checkpointing of every layer, and evaluate the checkpoint after 50 50 k steps.

blocks.en: In Tab. 4 , we provide an ablation study regarding different aspects of our method. First, we investigate which keys a patch attends to. Attending to every patch of the nearest clusters is the most accurate choice. Keeping only the 256 256 of them with the highest adjacency scores, as a per-query top- K K retrieval would, loses significant accuracy of AUC@30 in every setting. It is also slower, since selecting the keys costs more than attending to fewer of them saves. Second, we investigate what the clusters should be built on. Running k k -means on the raw tokens instead of the learned embeddings e i e_{i} is the largest single loss. This means that we need a good geometric representation of tokens, and the contrastive projection is what finds them. Third, we investigate the effectiveness of coarse key sets. Without the reference view, AUC@30 drops significantly at K = 100 K=100 views, and it also drops noticeably without the cluster summaries. Without both, it drops far more than the sum, to the level of raw-token clustering. This is because each set gives a patch a path to the scene beyond its nearest clusters, and at least one is needed. Together they add only P + N P+\sqrt{N} keys per patch and only 5 5 to 9 % 9\% of the time.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion and Discussion
blocks.zh: 5. 结论和讨论

blocks.en: In this paper, we presented SGAR, a general method that replaces the dense global attention of feed-forward reconstruction models with geometry-guided sparse attention. A learned projection embeds each patch such that patches observing the same surface lie close together, and our sparse geometric attention then selects a small subset of relevant keys for each query by clustering in this embedding space. We applied SGAR to two state-of-the-art dense-attention models and showed that it is the fastest model at every sequence length, up to 12 × 12\times faster than dense attention at 1,000 1{,}000 views, and the most accurate of the efficient alternatives, with accuracy comparable to the original dense models. Despite the good performance, SGAR also comes with limitations: sparsification still brings a small drop in accuracy relative to dense attention. Closing this gap is a promising direction for future work.
